title: The Absurdity of The Trinity (And The Hidden Three God Rule)

top_liked.author: @robweis9
top_liked.text: I want to play musical chairs with god, Jesus, and the holy spirit but I can't get a straight answer on how many chairs I'll need to bring

top_liked.author: @RaymondBCrisp
top_liked.text: I once heard this 'prayer' to be spoken before meals from a Catholic coworker, "Father, Son, and The Holy Ghost, whoever eats the fastest eats the most!"

top_liked.author: @WayneFerb
top_liked.text: Jesus calls the father "my god" all over the place (even in John), which is representing that god the father is in authority over him. He even explicitly says that he does the will of the father and "not my will but thine be done".

top_liked.author: @BlackTomorrowMusic
top_liked.text: I'll just worship Cerberus instead. It's less confusing.

top_liked.author: @BigTuk
top_liked.text: Judaism has always been wrestling with its inherent polytheism.

top_liked.author: @YeenMage
top_liked.text: The desperation of Trinitarian apologists, so much so that to defend this absurdity,  at one point they had to add/accept the Johannine Comma in 1 John 5:7-8 just to justify their  position.

top_liked.author: @peteroutlaw7207
top_liked.text: It is worse that the abandoned  thing. He had to kill  Jesus  for the sins that he made people  do as a part of his plan  and his will  to be done.  It makes no  sense.

top_liked.author: @shamusyu655
top_liked.text: If you ask me, most theistic religions seem to naturally lean towards having multiple deities, and monotheism is the rare, unnatural exception that might still have some traces of polytheistic themes if you look deep enough. That’s just my barely educated opinion, though.

top_liked.text: When I was 4 years old I thought everything in the Bible was absurd.
